item.title: MSc. MVA — École Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay
item.description:
Master MVA (Mathematics, Vision, Learning)

École Normale Supérieure Paris-Saclay | Université Paris-Saclay
September 2025 – Present

The MVA (Mathématiques, Vision, Apprentissage) master’s program is one of Europe’s most prestigious programs in applied mathematics and machine learning, attracting top students and researchers worldwide.

Curriculum Highlights

  • Mathematical Foundations: Probabilistic Graphical Models, Generative Graphical Models, Geoemtric Processing, Geometric Data Analysis
  • Learning: Geometric Deep Learning, Multimodal XAI, Generative Models for Images

item.title: MSc. CS Engineering — ENSTA Paris
item.description:
MSc. in Computer Science Engineering

ENSTA Paris | Institut Polytechnique de Paris
September 2023 – Present

ENSTA Paris, established in 1741, is France’s oldest engineering school and consistently ranks among the nation’s top institutions.

Curriculum Highlights

  • Core Engineering: Applied mathematics, physics, mechanics, signal processing
  • Computer Science Major (STIC): Object-oriented programming (C++, Java), microprocessor architecture, parallel programming, databases
  • Artifical Intelligence Specialization: Statistical Learning, Deep Learning, Machine learning, Image recognition, Language Modeling, Reinforcement Learning

Achievements

  • Cummulative GPA 4.05/4.3
  • Admitted to MVA program as a dual degree

item.title: Preparatory Classes MPSI/MP* — Moulay Youssef
item.description:
Classes Préparatoires MPSI/MP*

Moulay Youssef Preparatory School | Rabat, Morocco
September 2021 – June 2023 | Top 5% National Ranking

Intensive two-year program preparing for the highly competitive entrance examinations to France’s Grandes Écoles.

### Curriculum Highlights

  • Mathematics: Calculus, linear algebra, probability, differential equations, topology
  • Physics: Classical mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics, optics, quantum physics
  • Computer Science: Algorithms, data structures, complexity theory

Achievements

  • Top 5% ranking in national competitive examinations
  • Admitted to ENSTA Paris through the French Grandes Écoles entrance examination
